source.title: The Tiffin Girls' School — Curriculum Outline 2026-27 Department: French, Year 9
source.locator: Across Year 9: perfect tense and negatives; imperfect; perfect/imperfect in context; comparative and superlative; personal/family/friends; formal address; end-of-year revision of present, near future, simple future, perfect and imperfect

note.title: Assessment Practice — end-of-year mixed checkpoint
note.overview: A mixed end-of-year challenge that removes topic labels and forces the learner to diagnose the grammar independently.
learningGoals: Recognise when two time frames belong in the same answer.
mustMemoriseRules: Read the time marker before touching the verb.
workedExamples: Avant, je jouais… maintenant, je joue…
Hier, je suis allée à Paris, mais je n’ai pas pris le métro.
commonMistakes: Correcting vocabulary while leaving the tense error.
Using a near-future form when simple future is specifically requested.
Missing the negative around the auxiliary.
detailedExplanation: This is an app-built assessment-practice topic. The curriculum scope is verified against the official Tiffin Girls’ School Year 9 French Curriculum Outline 2026-27.

Where the school outline names an assessment, it does not publish the teacher’s exact live paper or complete mark scheme. This app therefore practises the verified skills without claiming to reproduce the teacher’s paper.
French accents are corrected and displayed, but a missing accent alone does not lose the mark in this app.
examTips: Underline the time clue before choosing a tense.
Answer every bullet before adding ambitious detail.
Use accurate short sentences rather than risky long sentences.
quickCheck: Recognise when two time frames belong in the same answer.
beforeStartingPractice: Do the first attempt without notes. Use the explanation only after submitting.
